title: Bayesian dynamic scheduling of multipurpose batch processes under incomplete look-ahead information
abstract: arXiv:2512.01093v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multipurpose batch processes become increasingly popular in manufacturing industries since they adapt to low-volume, high-value products and shifting demands. These processes often operate in a dynamic environment, which faces disturbances such as processing delays and demand changes. To minimise long-term cost and system nervousness (i.e., disruptive changes to schedules), schedulers must design rescheduling strategies to address such disturbances effectively. Existing methods often assume complete look-ahead information over the scheduling horizon. This assumption contrasts with realistic situations where schedulers can only access incomplete look-ahead information. Sticking with existing methods may lead to suboptimal long-term costs and high-level system nervousness. In this work we propose a Bayesian dynamic scheduling method. Our method relies on learning a Bayesian Network from the probability distribution of disturbances. Spe

translated_title: 不完整前瞻信息下多用途批处理过程的贝叶斯动态调度
translated_abstract: 多用途批处理过程因其能够适应低产量、高价值产品和不断变化的需求，在制造业中日益受到欢迎。这些过程通常在动态环境中运行，面临诸如加工延迟和需求变化等扰动。为了最小化长期成本和系统紧张性（即对调度产生的破坏性改变），调度员必须设计重调度策略以有效应对此类扰动。现有方法通常假设在整个调度范围内拥有完整的前瞻信息。这一假设与现实情况不符——实际中调度员只能获取不完整的前瞻信息。沿用现有方法可能导致次优的长期成本和高水平的系统紧张性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种贝叶斯动态调度方法。我们的方法依赖于从扰动的概率分布中学习贝叶斯网络。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于从扰动概率分布中学习贝叶斯网络的动态调度方法，使多用途批处理过程能够在仅拥有不完整前瞻信息的现实条件下有效应对扰动，从而最小化长期成本和系统紧张性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian dynamic scheduling method that learns a Bayesian Network from the probability distribution of disturbances, enabling multipurpose batch processes to effectively handle disruptions under realistic incomplete look-ahead information while minimizing long-term cost and system nervousness.
